blocks.title: Let's Sing!
blocks.body: Are you ready to sing Humpty Dumpty? It is one of the most fun songs!

blocks.title: Humpty Dumpty
blocks.content:
Humpty Dumpty sat on a wall,
Humpty Dumpty had a great fall.

blocks.title: For Parents & Teachers
blocks.content: Encourage the child to do the hand actions while singing this rhyme to build motor skills.
